The live file-select UI is tied to a specific preserved save-state load and Start event. Its graph camera, overlay callback, controller polling, and pressed-edge/held distinction are traced. Cursor movement/button activation, slot choice, and control outcomes were not exercised.

Static HUD paths do not prove runtime exposure for every mode; runtime HUD/pause/file-select observation does not cover dialogue, power-meter change, course-result, or title attract states.
